permits.name: Floodplain Development Permit

explanations.trigger_explanation: Development in Austin flood hazard areas likely requires floodplain permit review and, in some cases, FEMA map-revision sequencing before approval.

advisories: Additional review is recommended where the project modifies mapped flood elevations or channel geometry.
notes: Tier 2: official city floodplain regulations page verifies local review and permit sequencing; project details drive technical submittals.
